runs.content: Leidos trades at ~11.3x the midpoint of twice-raised FY26 adjusted EPS guidance and 32% below its 52-week high, a cheap defense/government-IT services name with no AI-capex or Burry-short overlap; TGT was trimmed (−5.21%) to hold the book at 35.

Johnson & Johnson was bought on its Q3 beat-and-raise (adj. EPS $2.59 vs $2.53, FY26 guidance raised on Tremfya +68% and Darzalex +15%) while flat over 3 months at ~23x forward; ISTR was exited as a capacity trim at $28.04 (−4.37%, −$44), and portfolio net P&L is +$2,371 (+2.86% on $83,000).
